intro: 🌙 EVENING EDITION! What a Fed-day Wednesday, fans. Since the afternoon drop our guy has posted a Halloween PSA about SPY puts hidden in candy bars, a 'Dad, stop scrolling Stocktwits' billboard, an all-caps plea to close the market, and some big-one energy for $MSFT earnings. Plus the Nintendogs meme, the Car Warsh pun, and more from earlier! 🎃🐶📈

items.caption: 🎃 HALLOWEEN PSA! Check your kids' candy, fam: some whacko has been stuffing SPY PUTS into bite-sized candy bars. A whole jack-o'-lantern bucket of them! Safety first, superfans.
👦 Right before $MSFT earnings, a kid on a billboard stares into your soul: "Dad, stop scrolling Stocktwits." Our guy's caption? "Dad, when do you report your earnings?" Brutal and beautiful.
items.quote: $SPY $MSFT  Dad, when do you report your earnings?

items.caption: 🔔 Fed day hits different: four exclamation points and ALL CAPS begging somebody to close the market. We hear you, champ.
💥 $MSFT earnings incoming and he's clutching his chest with a GIF: "Elizabeth this is the big one!!" Classic.
items.quote: $MSFT Elizabeth this is the big one!!

items.caption: 🐶 MEME OF THE DAY! A tired trader stares at a red $SPY chart while two sad puppies wait by empty bowls on his handheld: "I need this to go green / if imma feed my Nintendogs." Won't someone think of the pups?!
items.quote: $SPY $TSLA won’t someone please just think of the Nintendogs!

items.caption: 🧽 Pun alert! He's worried Warsh is gonna land him a new gig at the Car Warsh. Wordplay so clean you can see your reflection in it.
items.quote: $SPY $TSLA Warsh is going to have me working in a Car Warsh soon.

items.caption: 🎃 Pro tip from the master, GIF included: try pouring pumpkin spice on your trades. Seasonal strategy, baby!
items.quote: $SPY $TSLA Try pouring pumkin spice on your trades.

items.caption: 🐻 BREAKING: Someone found the bears playbook!!! Three exclamation points. The $SPY board has been warned.
🦘 When @GehrigDieter asked if anyone was missing a kangaroo in south Overland Park, our guy answered with the only correct response: "uhhh" plus a GIF. Iconic.
📉 Fresh off the press minutes ago: he says his rates don't FEEL unchanged. Relatable king. 💸
